capabilities: open links in the existing right-hand tab group instead of a new split
customize which click combo triggers the side open
reuse the side tab or open a new tab per click
keep focus in the current note while previewing
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Patches workspace.getLeaf("split") and internal APIs (children, parentSplit, leaf.parent) with guarded reads that fall back to native split behavior if Obsidian changes them.
intentEvidence: open a link in the existing tab group to the right, instead of creating a brand-new split every time
motivation: The author built it because native behavior 'stacks up a new column on each click, so previewing a handful of linked notes quickly shreds your layout', and wanted one reusable side column like Notion's side preview panel.
problem: Obsidian's Cmd+Alt+click always creates a new split, so previewing several linked notes quickly stacks columns and shreds the layout.
summary: Link-opening tweak that reuses the existing right-hand tab group for split previews instead of stacking a new split on every click.
